title: HttpsAcquisitionProvenanceRecord
description: Canonical schema for authenticated HTTPS evidence acquisition provenance records in Coin Behavior Engine.

source_url.description: Official target URL, must strictly use https scheme.

publisher_id.description: Identifier of the publisher (e.g. BLS, BEA).

acquisition_timestamp_utc.description: Exact UTC timestamp when the response was received.

http_status.description: HTTP status code; must be 200 OK.

content_type.description: MIME type of the acquired payload.

content_length.description: Byte length of response body, bounded by byte quota.

response_sha256.description: Deterministic SHA-256 digest of raw response bytes.

tls_verification_status.description: Status of TLS certificate and protocol verification.

tls_hostname_verified.description: Whether SNI and certificate SAN/CN strictly match canonical hostname.

certificate_chain_validation.description: Validation result of the X.509 certificate chain against trusted roots.

resolved_ip.description: Public IP address resolved via secure DNS resolution.

connected_ip.description: Socket connection remote IP; must match resolved_ip and not be private/loopback.

redirect_chain.description: List of redirect hops; cross-host redirects are prohibited.

network_authorization_id.description: Identifier of the signed ObservationAuthorizationToken authorizing network access.
